fusions.name: Flag in the Face
fusions.desc: Snaps the pennant tied to the staff through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Standard
fusions.desc: Drives the banner staff into a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Draped Awning
fusions.desc: Drapes cloth over the raised staff and veils you and your allies for 9 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 6% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Wound on the Distaff
fusions.desc: Every ability you use winds a stack of thread onto the staff, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
